snark._comment: Generated head-to-head snark. English-only by policy — fr.json (and every other locale) falls back here automatically. When translating, rewrite idiomatically: these are jokes, and a literal translation kills the punchline.
snark.eventsRunaway: {{big}} runs {{ratio}}× the events of {{small}}. One of you will not sleep; the other will be bored by Tuesday.
snark.eventsClose: {{big}} edges out {{small}} on raw event count — but it's close enough to call it a draw if you squint.
snark.art: {{big}} has {{bigArt}} art installations to the other's {{smallArt}}. Bring a wide-angle lens to one and your imagination to the other.
snark.music: {{big}} is the louder night out — {{bigMusic}} music sets vs {{smallMusic}}. Pack earplugs accordingly.
snark.durationLonger: {{longer}} runs longer ({{longDays}} days vs {{shortDays}}) — endurance event vs weekend warm-up.
snark.durationDenser: Same number of days, but {{denser}} crams more into each one. Choose your pace.
snark.regionSame: Civil war: both burns are in {{region}}. Loyalties will be tested.
snark.regionDiff: {{regionA}} vs {{regionB}} — this battle requires a passport.
snark.sanctionBoth: Both are official Burning Man regionals. The Org blesses this matchup.
snark.sanctionNeither: Neither is on the official BM list. Two rebels enter.
snark.sanctionOne: {{official}} carries the official BM regional badge; {{other}} is doing its own thing. Respect either way.
snark.vibeClash: Vibe clash: {{titleA}} leans {{traitA}}, {{titleB}} leans {{traitB}}. You already know which one is your scene.
snark.vibeSame: Both burns are {{trait}}-forward. Twins separated at birth.
